title: Blockchain Framework for Learner Performance Prediction using Life-Brain Storm-based Light GBM Coupled Neural Network
reason: Performance-prediction model on a non-public 'lively-generated' e-khool LMS dataset. Missing: who the learners are, their number and level, institution, collection period, and how performance is defined; sample rows carry 2001 timestamps. Reliability cannot be judged.

extraction.design: predictive modelling (LightGBM-coupled neural network) on secondary LMS data
extraction.population: nr (e-khool LMS learners, undescribed; '30000 available data' records, 3 courses)
extraction.lms_indicators: log-in/log-out time, time on course, page traversal, material type, learning time, chapters covered, lecture type, marks
extraction.outcome_or_construct: learner performance (target not defined in the text)
extraction.notes: Only model-fit metrics reported (MSE, RMSE, MAE, Kappa per course, e.g. proposed model Kappa 0.913 for course 1, Table 4); no indicator-level relation. Dataset: 'the lively-generated real time dataset with 30000 available data, collected and organized from the e-khool LMS, which is not publicly available'. 'mental state' and 'learning style' appear as input attributes without any description of measurement. Secondary: E3 undeterminable.
